status_note.explanation: git status lists the 8778 paths as worktree-modified because the index stat cache still records the hydrated file sizes. git diff is empty, hash-object --path equals the HEAD blob, and the worktree bytes match git cat-file. The real index was not refreshed or rewritten. update-index --refresh, tested only against a copy of the index, reports 'needs update' for these pointer files; cacheinfo of the same blob on that copy clears status. Doing that on the real index was not allowed.
